now: Talos meets Gravik at a London museum, and Fury picks up the rebels' trail across the city.
proposed: Talos meets Gravik at the National Portrait Gallery to negotiate a truce, and the talks break down when Gravik threatens to kill G'iah.
changes.evidence: In Betrayed, Gravik and G'iah meet Talos at the National Portrait Gallery in London, then move to a cafe where the parley collapses after Gravik threatens G'iah. Fury does not track the rebels across London: after meeting Talos at a pub, Fury and Talos drive to Commodore Fairbanks's house in Portsmouth to stop the missile launch.
